items.description_en:
Restores your vehicle's HP when you deal damage to an enemy tank. Also restores allied vehicle's HP by shooting or ramming it.
+25% of the total damage dealt is added to your vehicle's HP.
+60% of the average damage from a shell or potential damage by ramming is added to allied vehicle's HP.

Activates automatically. Permanent effect for one battle.
items.description_zh-Hans:
对敌方坦克造成伤害时恢复您战车的生命值。还可以通过射击或撞击恢复友军战车的生命值。
恢复等同于造成总伤害25%的生命值。
为友军战车恢复等同于炮弹平均伤害或潜在撞击伤害60%的生命值。

自动激活。效果持续一整场战斗。

items.description_en:
Increases damage dealt to an enemy tank by ramming. Decreases damage received from ramming.
+65% to damage dealt to an enemy tank by ramming.
-70% to damage received from ramming.

Activates automatically. Permanent effect for one battle.
items.description_zh-Hans:
提升对敌方坦克的撞击伤害。降低自身受到的撞击伤害。
+65%敌方坦克的撞击伤害。
-70%自身受到的撞击伤害。

自动激活。效果持续整场战斗。

50米内有存活的友军时，提升火炮的填装和瞄准速度以及视野范围。3名存活的友军可以提供最大加成。
每名存活的友军会提供：
+20%火炮填装速度。
+20%瞄准速度。
+20%视野范围。

自动激活。效果持续整场战斗。

items.description_en:
Once your vehicle is spotted, the light bulb appears immediately. If your vehicle is beyond spotting range, it immediately becomes invisible to the enemy team and disappears from the minimap.

Activates automatically. Permanent effect for one battle.
items.description_zh-Hans:
一旦您的战车被发现，灯泡会立即出现。如果您的战车在侦察范围之外，将立即变为不可见并消失在小地图上。

自动激活。效果持续整场战斗。

items.description_zh-Hans: 受到致命伤害时，您的坦克不会被摧毁而是保留1点生命值。弹药架爆炸不会生效。
